fields.name: sentence
fields.label: Sentence
fields.default: We take twenty-six measurements, draft a paper pattern that is yours alone, fit the cloth on you twice and finish every buttonhole by hand.
fields.help: Make a phrase bold to give it the next note number.

default.title: The measuring
default.text: Allow an hour at the shop on Call Lane. We note how you stand, which shoulder drops and where you keep your phone.

default.title: The pattern
default.text: Drawn in pencil on brown paper and kept on file, so your second suit needs only one visit.

default.title: The fittings
default.text: First in basted cloth held with white thread, then four weeks later with the sleeves set and the lining in.

default.title: The finishing
default.text: A jacket has around forty hours of handwork in it. Yours is ready ten to twelve weeks after the first visit.
